text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oho! So when you get a nosebleed, you
should
pinch your nostrils for about ten
minutes?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've heard a lot of people say you should
tilt your
head back, but I never knew
about this! Sounds
worth a try!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I doubt my nose will start bleeding on
cue, though. Oh, now that I think about
it, I got a
nosebleed once when I ran a
whole lot...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... M-my nose... It just won't bleed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much she runs, 
Matikanetannhauser's nose doesn't
bleed, and
she only succeeds in
exhausting herself.
